name: Kitty Game
author: Cannon Tuttle
description: Find the kitties! Run, jump and use cards to track them all down. Arrows to move, X and Z to jump and use cards.

descriptions.en: Find the kitties! Run, jump and use cards to track them all down. Arrows to move, X and Z to jump and use cards.
descriptions.it: Trova i gattini! Corri, salta e usa le carte per scovarli tutti. Frecce per muoverti, X e Z per saltare e usare le carte.
